reviews.text: Excellent experience with Parker's Landscaping LLC! They were reliable, showed up on time, and completed the work with great care and professionalism. The quality of their landscaping work was impressive, and the whole process was smooth from start to finish.
Parker is a very hard worker at 18 yrs Old.  He has helped restore my grass from the destruction of my 5 pups and makes all my projects come to life.  I highly recommend him!!

I hired Parker in Spring ’25 for a backyard cleanup, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. He handled weeding, mulching, and grass seeding with great care, and even followed up afterward to address my concerns. Parker is reliable, responsive, and respectful. I was surprised to see so few reviews, but I can confidently say I’m very impressed and will gladly use his services again. Highly recommend!
